metadata.label: Clownfish
metadata.description: Adds a few small warm glowing fish that wander, hide among jelly tentacles and dart away when startled. In the space theme they become DJ hippo aliens in flying saucers that hover near the comets.

image.label: Image
image.description: Image to add the fish on top of.

image.label: Image
image.description: Image with glowing fish added.

controlDescriptions.bandWidth: Width of the white stripes. 0 removes them.
controlDescriptions.boldness: Extra multiplier on hide time per fish personality. Higher means longer hiding.
controlDescriptions.count: Number of fish swimming in the scene (up to 40).
controlDescriptions.curiosity: Chance that a fish heads for a jelly to hide instead of keeping on wandering. 0 never hides.
controlDescriptions.dartSpeed: Extra multiplier for the burst speed when a fish darts away.
controlDescriptions.edgeAvoid: How early fish turn away from the screen edges. 0 lets them swim right to the edge.
controlDescriptions.finSize: Scale of the tail, dorsal, ventral and pectoral fins.
controlDescriptions.glow: Strength of the soft glow halo around each fish.
controlDescriptions.hideTime: Average seconds a fish lingers hidden in the tentacles before darting out. 0 means no hiding.
controlDescriptions.hue: Shifts the warm gold and coral fish colors around the color wheel.
controlDescriptions.hueVariety: How much each fish differs in color from the others. 0 makes every fish the same.
controlDescriptions.outline: Thickness of the dark outline around the body, fins and stripes. 0 removes it.
controlDescriptions.schooling: How strongly wandering fish follow and align with their nearest neighbor. 0 swims independently.
controlDescriptions.size: Global size multiplier: base fish length in screen units (screen height is 2).
controlDescriptions.sizeMax: Largest fish size as a multiple of Size. Swapped with Size min if smaller.
controlDescriptions.sizeMin: Smallest fish size as a multiple of Size. Swapped with Size max if larger.
controlDescriptions.sizeVariety: How evenly fish sizes spread between min and max. 0 clusters them at the middle size, 1 spreads them fully.
controlDescriptions.speed: Master multiplier for cruise and dart speed.
controlDescriptions.startle: How easily bass onsets and nearby shockwaves startle hiding fish into darting. 0 disables.
controlDescriptions.tailWiggle: Amount of tail sway and body ripple while swimming. 0 holds the tail rigid. In space it sets the saucer wobble.
controlDescriptions.wake: Brightness of the trail left behind swimming and darting fish (a sparkly ion trail in space). 0 disables it.
controlDescriptions.wakeLength: How long the wake trail lingers behind a fish. Longer means a longer trail.
controlDescriptions.wanderiness: How randomly free-swimming fish change direction. 0 swims straight, higher meanders.

metadata.label: Deep Space Finish
metadata.description: Final grade: highlight bloom, filmic shoulder that never clips to white, vignette, grain, edge chromatic aberration; aquarium depth grade with caustics, space deep blacks with cyan shadows.

image.label: Image
image.description: Image to grade.

image.label: Image
image.description: Graded image.

controlDescriptions.aberration: Tiny red and blue color fringing toward the edges.
controlDescriptions.bloom: Strength of the soft glow around highlights.
controlDescriptions.exposure: Brightness before the highlight roll-off. Highlights ease toward white instead of clipping.
controlDescriptions.grade: Strength of the theme grade: aquarium depth tint, space cyan shadows, and split toning.
controlDescriptions.grain: Strength of the faint animated film grain.
controlDescriptions.vignette: Darkening at the frame corners. 0.25 darkens the corners by about 25%.

metadata.label: Starlight Rays
metadata.description: Aquarium: volumetric god-rays with dust in the shafts. Space: a star lens flare. Audio level brightens both.

image.label: Image
image.description: Scene image to light with rays and bloom.

image.label: Image
image.description: Image with starlight rays and bloom.

controlDescriptions.angle: Slant of the shafts in radians.
controlDescriptions.bloom: Strength of the soft glow around bright areas.
controlDescriptions.dust: Brightness of the dust motes caught in the shafts.
controlDescriptions.flare: Strength of the space-theme star lens flare.
controlDescriptions.opacity: Overall opacity of the rays, flare and bloom layer.
controlDescriptions.speed: How fast the shafts drift and flicker.

metadata.label: Kick Punch
metadata.description: On each bass kick, zooms slightly toward the center, blooms bright areas and lifts exposure, then eases back.

image.label: Image
image.description: Image to punch on each kick.

image.label: Image
image.description: Image with a zoom, bloom and flash on each kick.

controlDescriptions.bloom: Strength of the soft glow added to bright parts on a kick.
controlDescriptions.flash: Small exposure lift on a kick.
controlDescriptions.release: Seconds the punch takes to ease back after the peak.
controlDescriptions.sensitivity: How easily a bass hit counts as a kick. Higher values trigger on softer hits.
controlDescriptions.zoom: How far the frame pushes toward the center on a kick. 0 turns the zoom off.

metadata.label: Cosmic Nebula
metadata.description: Adds a dim drifting magenta and teal gas nebula near the screen edges; bass brightens it gently.

image.label: Image
image.description: Image to add the nebula behind.

image.label: Image
image.description: Image with a faint nebula added.

controlDescriptions.bassGlow: How strongly bass brightens the nebula.
controlDescriptions.brightness: Overall nebula strength. It stays dim at every setting.
controlDescriptions.drift: How fast the gas clouds drift.
controlDescriptions.hue: Tint blended into the magenta and teal gas.
controlDescriptions.scale: Size of the cloud features. Higher values give smaller clouds.

metadata.label: Jellyfish Bell
metadata.description: Glowing translucent jellyfish swarm over deep space; bass onsets make one jelly emit a shockwave.

image.label: Image
image.description: Bell over space.

controlDescriptions.armCount: Number of frilly oral arms near the centre.
controlDescriptions.armLength: Oral arm length relative to the tentacles.
controlDescriptions.autoBlend: How long an automatic theme transition takes.
controlDescriptions.autoMax: Longest time between automatic theme toggles.
controlDescriptions.autoMin: Shortest time between automatic theme toggles.
controlDescriptions.autoTheme: When 1, the theme toggles between Aquarium and Space on its own at random intervals.
controlDescriptions.beatDots: Amount of the eased downward dot-flow step added on each detected beat, on top of the continuous flow.
controlDescriptions.beatStep: Beat step size in dot spacings (scaled by Beat dots and Reactivity); eases in over about 0.15 s.
controlDescriptions.bellGlow: Inner light of each translucent bell: apex glow, glowing margin, subsurface tint and luminous ribs.
controlDescriptions.brightness: Multiplies jelly color before the soft tone curve.
controlDescriptions.cometTrail: Brightness of comet tails in space mode, relative to the tentacle glow.
controlDescriptions.count: Number of jellyfish floating on screen.
controlDescriptions.currentSpread: Slow per-jelly water current: tentacle tips fan wider and drift together in a slowly changing direction; 0 disables.
controlDescriptions.depthHaze: Smaller (farther) jellies get softer, blurred and tinted toward violet-blue haze; close ones gain a soft halo. 0 disables.
controlDescriptions.depthSpeed: Parallax: scales drift, lunge and glide speed by each jelly size relative to Size max, so closer jellies move faster; 0 disables.
controlDescriptions.dotSpacing: How many dots appear along each tentacle.
controlDescriptions.dotSpeed: How fast glowing dots flow down the tentacles.
controlDescriptions.dotSpeedVariation: How much dot speed differs between tentacles.
controlDescriptions.headingSpread: How widely jellyfish headings spread away from up; 1 gives about plus or minus 100 degrees, with a few drifting down-diagonal.
controlDescriptions.heroLead: Hero jelly inner glow follows the overall level; its hue slides from warm (low spectral centroid) to cool (high).
controlDescriptions.heroRoam: How freely the hero roams: it swims toward a new random point every 8-15 s within about 80% of the screen and stays on screen; 0 keeps it in its home box.
controlDescriptions.heroSize: Jelly 0 becomes a slow hero this many times Size max, drifting in the left or right third and staying on screen; 0 disables.
controlDescriptions.hueVariety: How far each jellyfish hue spreads around the color wheel; 0 uses the base hue for all.
controlDescriptions.idleInterval: Fire a shockwave anyway if nothing fired for this many seconds; 0 disables.
controlDescriptions.lengthVariation: How much shorter some tentacles are.
controlDescriptions.lunge: Forward distance a jellyfish lunges along its heading during each contraction (power stroke); it then coasts.
controlDescriptions.pulse: How strongly bass contracts the bell.
controlDescriptions.reactivity: Master scale for all audio reactions.
controlDescriptions.rimSpectrum: Circular equaliser: the bell rim glows and swells outward with the spectrum band at each rim angle.
controlDescriptions.ringCount: Concentric rings per shockwave: one bright leading ring plus fainter trailing ones.
controlDescriptions.ringSpacing: Gap between successive rings, in screen units, scaled by the jelly size.
controlDescriptions.sizeMax: Largest jellyfish scale, as a multiplier of Size. The largest scale is the nearest depth: full brightness and full speed.
controlDescriptions.sizeMin: Smallest jellyfish scale, as a multiplier of Size. Each jelly picks a stable random scale between min and max (swapped if min > max).
controlDescriptions.speedVariation: Per-jelly differences in speed, lunge and stroke tempo; 1 gives about 0.4x to 1.8x.
controlDescriptions.spread: Horizontal spread of the swarm; 1 spans the full screen width, 0 stacks them at the centre, 2 spreads past both edges.
controlDescriptions.strokeDepth: How far the bell margin closes inward and down during each contraction (the dome stays rounded); 0 disables the squeeze.
controlDescriptions.sway: How strongly mids make the tentacles sway.
controlDescriptions.swimFrequency: Average pulse bursts per second for each jellyfish; bursts come at random intervals.
controlDescriptions.tentacleFlow: How much tentacles drift, fan out and sway in the water current; 0 keeps them trailing straight.
controlDescriptions.tentacleLength: Longest tentacle length relative to bell size.
controlDescriptions.tentacleSpectrum: Maps the spectrum across each jelly's tentacles (low on one side, high on the other); each band brightens its tentacle line and dots.
controlDescriptions.theme: Master scene theme. 0 is the aquarium; 1 is space, where each jellyfish morphs in place into a comet: tentacles straighten into a curved warm dust tail and a straight flickering blue ion tail, then the bell rounds into an icy nucleus and glowing coma, then colours shift. Strokes become coma pulses, motion turns ballistic and shockwaves become solar flares. Other scene parts follow this value.
controlDescriptions.thrust: How far each bell stroke pushes a jellyfish along its heading.
controlDescriptions.tilt: Extra slow wandering of each heading, in radians.
controlDescriptions.toneSoftness: Coefficient k in col/(1+col*k); higher compresses highlights more.
controlDescriptions.trails: Brightness of the dissolving glowing specks left behind each lunge (last 3 lunges, fade in about 1.5 s); 0 disables.
controlDescriptions.triggerSensitivity: How easily bass, broadband-flux and snare onsets fire shockwaves; higher lowers the onset thresholds.
controlDescriptions.waveDistortion: Directly scales how strongly shockwaves bend the image (refraction amplitude); 20 is a strong warp.
controlDescriptions.wavePush: A passing shockwave pushes and splays tentacles away from its origin, then they spring back over about 1.5 s; 0 disables.
controlDescriptions.waveReach: How far a shockwave travels, in aspect-corrected screen units, before it fades out and is recycled.
controlDescriptions.waveSpeed: How fast shockwaves expand, in screen units per second.

metadata.label: Distant Galaxy
metadata.description: Adds one slowly rotating spiral galaxy far in the background: pink HII knots, a yellow bulge and blue outer arms in space, a soft dreamy blur through water. Bass brightens its core slightly.

image.label: Image
image.description: Image to add the galaxy behind.

image.label: Image
image.description: Image with a faint distant galaxy added.

controlDescriptions.brightness: Overall galaxy strength. It stays very dim at every setting.
controlDescriptions.positionX: Horizontal position of the galaxy centre across the frame.
controlDescriptions.positionY: Vertical position of the galaxy centre across the frame.
controlDescriptions.rotationSpeed: How fast the spiral turns. Zero holds it still.
controlDescriptions.size: Radius of the galaxy as a fraction of the frame height.

metadata.label: Shockwave Warp
metadata.description: Refracts the whole frame at every jellyfish shockwave front, with a chromatic split and a slight ring brightening.

image.label: Image
image.description: Finished frame to distort.

image.label: Image
image.description: Frame with shockwave refraction.

controlDescriptions.chroma: How far the red and blue channels separate inside the band.
controlDescriptions.mirror: Off (0): pixels pushed past the frame edge repeat the edge. On (1): the frame mirrors, so huge displacements stay detailed.
controlDescriptions.strength: Displacement amount. At 1 the peak shift is about 3% of the frame height; high values push pixels beyond the screen.
controlDescriptions.width: Thickness of the refracting band around each shockwave front.

image.label: Image
image.description: Image

metadata.label: Star Plankton
metadata.description: Adds drifting bioluminescent motes with bokeh depth (aquarium) or colourful stardust and tumbling asteroids (space); highs make them sparkle.

image.label: Image
image.description: Image to add plankton over.

image.label: Image
image.description: Image with drifting plankton.

controlDescriptions.density: How many grid cells hold a plankton mote.
controlDescriptions.drift: How fast the motes rise and drift.
controlDescriptions.scatter: How far hi-hat surges push nearby motes outward before they resettle.
controlDescriptions.scatterGlow: How much motes brighten while a surge passes through them.
controlDescriptions.scatterRadius: Size of the area around each surge epicenter that is affected.
controlDescriptions.size: Size of each glowing mote; near motes are also softly out of focus.
controlDescriptions.sparkle: How strongly highs make motes flash brighter.

metadata.label: Aurora Veil
metadata.description: Adds soft caustic light ribbons under water, or the Milky Way with dense stars, dust rifts and a warm core in space, over dark areas.

image.label: Image
image.description: Image to add the veil to.

image.label: Image
image.description: Image with a faint drifting veil of light added to dark areas.

controlDescriptions.angle: Drift direction in radians. 0 drifts left to right.
controlDescriptions.brightness: Strength of the veil. It stays very faint at every setting.
controlDescriptions.hueShift: Slides the teal, violet and gold colors along the band. In space it slides the warm Milky Way core.
controlDescriptions.period: Seconds between one band and the next crossing the frame.
controlDescriptions.width: Band width as a fraction of the screen.

metadata.label: Spectrum Kelp
metadata.description: Adds a dim, layered background of sun-dappled kelp fronds in uneven clumps across the full width. Each frond follows one spectrum band.

image.label: Image
image.description: Image to add the kelp behind.

image.label: Image
image.description: Image with faint kelp added in dark areas.

controlDescriptions.bandMapping: 0 maps low to high frequencies from left to right. 1 assigns bands in a hashed order.
controlDescriptions.brightness: Overall kelp glow. It stays dim and only shows in dark areas.
controlDescriptions.clumping: 0 spaces fronds evenly. 1 groups them in uneven clumps spread edge to edge, with a few strays.
controlDescriptions.count: Number of kelp fronds. Each frond is one spectrum band.
controlDescriptions.height: Frond reach as a fraction of the frame height. Quiet bands rest at 25% of it; loud bands climb to about 135%, and kicks stretch them further.
controlDescriptions.hue: Tint of the emissive tips and nodes. Bands spread the hue across the row.
controlDescriptions.response: How strongly band loudness raises and kicks the fronds.
controlDescriptions.seed: Changes the random clump layout and depth layers.
controlDescriptions.sensitivity: Scales each auto-gained band before the response curve. Raise it to make quiet music move the fronds more.
controlDescriptions.smoothing: Spring time of the frond motion. 0 is quick and tight, 0.5 rises in about 120 ms and settles in about 600 ms, 1 is slow and fluid.
controlDescriptions.sway: Strength of the slow current and traveling waves along each frond.

metadata.label: Distant Whale
metadata.description: A dim, hazy humpback silhouette slowly crosses far in the background; bass can make it sing a faint ring.

image.label: Image
image.description: Image to add the whale behind.

image.label: Image
image.description: Image with a faint distant whale added in dark areas.

controlDescriptions.brightness: Strength of the silhouette, rim light and glowing spots. It stays dim.
controlDescriptions.crossTime: Seconds the whale takes to cross the frame. A pause follows each crossing.
controlDescriptions.depth: Amount of depth fog and softness. Higher values push the whale farther back.
controlDescriptions.direction: 0 swims left to right, 1 swims right to left, 2 alternates each crossing.
controlDescriptions.height: Vertical lane of the swim path. Zero is the screen center.
controlDescriptions.hue: Tint of the bioluminescent rim and spots.
controlDescriptions.size: Whale length relative to screen height. Small values read as farther away.
controlDescriptions.song: How strongly bass makes the whale emit a faint ring from its head.

metadata.label: Shooting Stars
metadata.description: Adds shooting stars (space) or refracting bubble groups (aquarium) on bass and onset beats.

image.label: Image
image.description: Image to add shooting stars on top of.

image.label: Image
image.description: Image with beat-driven shooting stars added.

controlDescriptions.beatSensitivity: How easily a bass or broadband onset counts as a beat. Higher values trigger on weaker hits.
controlDescriptions.brightnessMax: Brightest glow a new star can pick.
controlDescriptions.brightnessMin: Dimmest glow a new star can pick.
controlDescriptions.idleSpawn: Random stars per minute with no beat. Zero turns idle stars off.
controlDescriptions.lengthMax: Longest tail a new star can pick.
controlDescriptions.lengthMin: Shortest tail a new star can pick.
controlDescriptions.minGap: Shortest time in seconds between two beat-spawned stars.
controlDescriptions.sizeMax: Thickest head and tail (or largest bubble scale) a new spawn can pick.
controlDescriptions.sizeMin: Thinnest head and tail (or smallest bubble scale) a new spawn can pick.
controlDescriptions.speed: How fast each star crosses the frame, or bubbles rise.

publicControls.label: Aquarium ↔ Space
publicControls.description: Master scene theme. 0 is the aquarium; 1 is space, where each jellyfish morphs in place into a comet: tentacles straighten into a curved warm dust tail and a straight flickering blue ion tail, then the bell rounds into an icy nucleus and glowing coma, then colours shift. Strokes become coma pulses, motion turns ballistic and shockwaves become solar flares. Other scene parts follow this value.

publicControls.label: Auto toggle
publicControls.description: When 1, the theme toggles between Aquarium and Space on its own at random intervals.

publicControls.label: Toggle min (s)
publicControls.description: Shortest time between automatic theme toggles.

publicControls.label: Toggle max (s)
publicControls.description: Longest time between automatic theme toggles.

publicControls.label: Transition (s)
publicControls.description: How long an automatic theme transition takes.

publicControls.label: Comet trail brightness
publicControls.description: Brightness of comet tails in space mode, relative to the tentacle glow.

publicControls.label: Size
publicControls.description: Bell radius.

publicControls.label: Dome height
publicControls.description: Dome height relative to width.

publicControls.label: Bass pulse
publicControls.description: How strongly bass contracts the bell.

publicControls.label: Halo
publicControls.description: Soft glow around the bell.

publicControls.label: Hue
publicControls.description: Base bell color.

publicControls.label: Hue variety
publicControls.description: How far each jellyfish hue spreads around the color wheel; 0 uses the base hue for all.

publicControls.label: Count
publicControls.description: Number of tentacles.

publicControls.label: Length
publicControls.description: Longest tentacle length relative to bell size.

publicControls.label: Length variation
publicControls.description: How much shorter some tentacles are.

publicControls.label: Glow
publicControls.description: Tentacle brightness.

publicControls.label: Speed
publicControls.description: How fast glowing dots flow down the tentacles.

publicControls.label: Speed variation
publicControls.description: How much dot speed differs between tentacles.

publicControls.label: Density
publicControls.description: How many dots appear along each tentacle.

publicControls.label: Count
publicControls.description: Number of frilly oral arms near the centre.

publicControls.label: Length
publicControls.description: Oral arm length relative to the tentacles.

publicControls.label: Glow
publicControls.description: Oral arm brightness.

publicControls.label: Mids sway
publicControls.description: How strongly mids make the tentacles sway.

publicControls.label: Reactivity
publicControls.description: Master scale for all audio reactions.

publicControls.label: Count
publicControls.description: Number of jellyfish floating on screen.

publicControls.label: Size min
publicControls.description: Smallest jellyfish scale, as a multiplier of Size. Each jelly picks a stable random scale between min and max (swapped if min > max).

publicControls.label: Size max
publicControls.description: Largest jellyfish scale, as a multiplier of Size. The largest scale is the nearest depth: full brightness and full speed.

publicControls.label: Tilt
publicControls.description: Extra slow wandering of each heading, in radians.

publicControls.label: Drift speed
publicControls.description: How fast jellyfish drift upward.

publicControls.label: Wave speed
publicControls.description: How fast shockwaves expand, in screen units per second.

publicControls.label: Cooldown
publicControls.description: Minimum seconds between shockwave triggers.

publicControls.label: Trigger sensitivity
publicControls.description: How easily bass, broadband-flux and snare onsets fire shockwaves; higher lowers the onset thresholds.

publicControls.label: Idle interval
publicControls.description: Fire a shockwave anyway if nothing fired for this many seconds; 0 disables.

publicControls.label: Brightness
publicControls.description: Multiplies jelly color before the soft tone curve.

publicControls.label: Tone softness
publicControls.description: Coefficient k in col/(1+col*k); higher compresses highlights more.

publicControls.label: Swim frequency
publicControls.description: Average pulse bursts per second for each jellyfish; bursts come at random intervals.

publicControls.label: Thrust
publicControls.description: How far each bell stroke pushes a jellyfish along its heading.

publicControls.label: Stroke depth
publicControls.description: How far the bell margin closes inward and down during each contraction (the dome stays rounded); 0 disables the squeeze.

publicControls.label: Lunge
publicControls.description: Forward distance a jellyfish lunges along its heading during each contraction (power stroke); it then coasts.

publicControls.label: Distortion
publicControls.description: Directly scales how strongly shockwaves bend the image (refraction amplitude); 20 is a strong warp.

publicControls.label: Ring count
publicControls.description: Concentric rings per shockwave: one bright leading ring plus fainter trailing ones.

publicControls.label: Ring spacing
publicControls.description: Gap between successive rings, in screen units, scaled by the jelly size.

publicControls.label: Spread
publicControls.description: Horizontal spread of the swarm; 1 spans the full screen width, 0 stacks them at the centre, 2 spreads past both edges.

publicControls.label: Reach
publicControls.description: How far a shockwave travels, in aspect-corrected screen units, before it fades out and is recycled.

publicControls.label: Flow
publicControls.description: How much tentacles drift, fan out and sway in the water current; 0 keeps them trailing straight.

publicControls.label: Heading spread
publicControls.description: How widely jellyfish headings spread away from up; 1 gives about plus or minus 100 degrees, with a few drifting down-diagonal.

publicControls.label: Speed variation
publicControls.description: Per-jelly differences in speed, lunge and stroke tempo; 1 gives about 0.4x to 1.8x.

publicControls.label: Depth speed
publicControls.description: Parallax: scales drift, lunge and glide speed by each jelly size relative to Size max, so closer jellies move faster; 0 disables.

publicControls.label: Inner glow
publicControls.description: Inner light of each translucent bell: apex glow, glowing margin, subsurface tint and luminous ribs.

publicControls.label: Depth haze
publicControls.description: Smaller (farther) jellies get softer, blurred and tinted toward violet-blue haze; close ones gain a soft halo. 0 disables.

publicControls.label: Hero size
publicControls.description: Jelly 0 becomes a slow hero this many times Size max, drifting in the left or right third and staying on screen; 0 disables.

publicControls.label: Light trails
publicControls.description: Brightness of the dissolving glowing specks left behind each lunge (last 3 lunges, fade in about 1.5 s); 0 disables.

publicControls.label: Tentacle spectrum
publicControls.description: Maps the spectrum across each jelly's tentacles (low on one side, high on the other); each band brightens its tentacle line and dots.

publicControls.label: Rim spectrum
publicControls.description: Circular equaliser: the bell rim glows and swells outward with the spectrum band at each rim angle.

publicControls.label: Hero lead
publicControls.description: Hero jelly inner glow follows the overall level; its hue slides from warm (low spectral centroid) to cool (high).

publicControls.label: Beat dots
publicControls.description: Amount of the eased downward dot-flow step added on each detected beat, on top of the continuous flow.

publicControls.label: Beat step
publicControls.description: Beat step size in dot spacings (scaled by Beat dots and Reactivity); eases in over about 0.15 s.

publicControls.label: Hero roam
publicControls.description: How freely the hero roams: it swims toward a new random point every 8-15 s within about 80% of the screen and stays on screen; 0 keeps it in its home box.

publicControls.label: Current spread
publicControls.description: Slow per-jelly water current: tentacle tips fan wider and drift together in a slowly changing direction; 0 disables.

publicControls.label: Tentacle push
publicControls.description: A passing shockwave pushes and splays tentacles away from its origin, then they spring back over about 1.5 s; 0 disables.
